instructions: Self-hosted Shlink URL shortener. Use these tools to create, list, edit, and analyse short links, manage tags and domains, and inspect visit analytics. The server talks to Shlink server-to-server with a single API key - your caller identity is authenticated via OAuth.

descriptions.create_short_url: Create a new short URL. Provide longUrl (required) and optionally customSlug, tags, domain, validSince, validUntil, maxVisits, title.
descriptions.list_short_urls: List short URLs, optionally filtered by search term, tags, or date range. Supports pagination via `page` and `itemsPerPage`.
descriptions.get_short_url_visits: Return paginated visit data for a single short URL. Filter by startDate, endDate, domain, or excludeBots.
descriptions.set_redirect_rules: REPLACES the whole redirect-rule set of a short URL with the given redirectRules list; the list order is the evaluation priority (first rule wins). To add or change one rule, call get_redirect_rules first and send the complete list, unchanged rules included. An empty list removes every rule.
descriptions.delete_orphan_visits: IRREVERSIBLE: permanently deletes ALL orphan visits on this Shlink instance (visits to the base URL, to invalid short codes and other 404s). Takes no filter. Only call when the user explicitly asks for it.
descriptions.delete_short_url_visits: IRREVERSIBLE: permanently deletes every recorded visit of one short URL; the short URL itself stays. Only call when the user explicitly asks for it.

tools.name: export_short_urls
tools.title: Export Short URLs
tools.description: Bulk-export every short URL on this Shlink instance as CSV or JSON. Runs as an MCP task — the AI receives a task_id and polls until completion. Pages through the entire inventory; large instances may take a few seconds.
